facts.fact: The Interior ministry's local governance director announced the official launch of RNA generalisation in the communes of Ouargla wilaya, to be extended gradually to all wilayas, per El Watan.
The Oran pilot wilaya produced 311,000 official, unified, geographically locatable addresses, per the ministry's local governance director.
